flashChatNative.welcome: Create or join a room to talk directly. No account needed.
flashChatNative.inviteHint: Copy the invitation to the other person. Paste it into Flash Chat to enter the same room.
flashChatNative.keyboard: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
flashChatNative.communityHint: Choose a room, then select Enter room. Members of a public room can read its group messages.
flashChatNative.identityHint: Compare public keys with the other person to confirm their identity.
flashChatNative.enableDeviceHint: Enable the camera or microphone and grant access first. Available devices then appear here.
flashChatNative.embedHint: Enter your deployed website address, then copy the embed code. The website must provide a compatible chat page and SDK.
flashChatNative.resetHint: Delete your current identity, keys and Flash Chat settings, and leave the room. A new identity is created next time. This cannot be undone.
flashChatNative.helpRooms: Rooms: enter the same room ID to meet. Private rooms also require the same password. Public rooms share message history with new members; private rooms do not.
flashChatNative.helpPrivacy: Direct messages: select a member to talk only with them. Switching conversations or pages keeps your room and drafts. Closing the window leaves the room.
flashChatNative.helpMedia: Calls: use the microphone, camera and screen buttons to start or stop sharing. Devices and volume lets you choose devices and adjust or mute each member.
flashChatNative.helpFiles: Files: use the file button beside the composer, or drop local files into it. Files are encrypted before sharing. Other members receive them from the member list. Stop sharing withdraws the offer.
flashChatNative.helpNetwork: Connection: both sides must keep Flash Chat running. Check network settings and relay availability if connection fails. Network changes apply the next time you enter a room.
flashChatNative.sound: Play a sound for background messages
flashChatNative.networkHint: Leave blank to use the defaults. Changes apply the next time you enter a room.
flashChatNative.trackers: Pairing servers (one WebSocket URL per line)
flashChatNative.invalidJSON: Invalid JSON. Check the network configuration.
flashChatNative.profileHint: Your profile contains identity keys and chat settings. Export it to move to another device. Keep the file private. Importing leaves the current room.
flashChatNative.filesOnly: Select local files. Folders cannot be shared directly.
flashChatNative.startHint: Enter the same room ID to connect with others.
